'''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''' is part of the {{c|Grand Theft Auto}} video-game series. In order to advance in the games of this series, a player must engage in car-jacking and other criminal acts. This was one of the most popular games when it was released and is played in a free roaming world where the player can do almost anything. The game was created based on gangster behavior and actions.

==Story==
In this game you play Carl "CJ" Johnson who has been called from his time away in Liberty City, to his home of Ganton in Los Santos, San Andreas to attend his mother's funeral and determine the identity of her killer. CJ gets a lot of surprises upon his return, all of which add to the urban gangster feel of the game.
